seoContent.title: SEO Content
seoContent.description: Manage meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter cards, and schema for pages. Cache is cleared automatically on update.
seoContent.confirmDeleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this SEO page?
seoContent.hintPageType: Kind of page: home, listing, vehicle, static, dealer, blog, etc. Used to match this SEO entry to the right page.
seoContent.hintPageKey: Unique identifier or slug for this page (e.g. home, vehicles, about, contact, privacy-policy, or a vehicle/dealer slug).
seoContent.hintTitle: Human-readable page title, e.g. for breadcrumbs or headings.
seoContent.hintMetaTitle: Title shown in the browser tab and in search results. Keep it under 60 characters.
seoContent.hintMetaDescription: Short summary for search results. Aim for 150–160 characters.
seoContent.hintMetaKeywords: Optional comma-separated keywords. Less important for SEO but still supported.
seoContent.hintCanonicalUrl: Preferred URL for this page to avoid duplicate content. Leave empty to use the current page URL.
seoContent.hintRobots: Search engine directives, e.g. index, follow or noindex, nofollow.
seoContent.hintOgTitle: Title when this page is shared on Facebook, LinkedIn, etc.
seoContent.hintOgDescription: Description shown when the page is shared on social networks.
seoContent.hintOgImage: Full URL of the image shown when the page is shared (e.g. on Facebook).
seoContent.hintTwitterTitle: Title used for Twitter card previews.
seoContent.hintTwitterDescription: Description used for Twitter card previews.
seoContent.hintTwitterImage: Full URL of the image used for Twitter cards.
seoContent.hintSchemaType: Type of structured data, e.g. Vehicle, Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList.
seoContent.hintSchemaJson: JSON-LD structured data for search engines. Must be valid JSON. Used for rich results and knowledge panels.
seoContent.hintContentHtml: Optional HTML block for extra SEO content rendered on the page.
seoContent.hintFaqJson: FAQ structured data as a JSON array (question/answer pairs) for FAQ rich results.
seoContent.hintBreadcrumbsJson: Breadcrumb trail as JSON for BreadcrumbList structured data.
seoContent.pageTypeKeyRequired: Page type and page key are required

aboutPageContent.title: About Page Content Management
aboutPageContent.description: Manage all text content and images on the about page. Changes are saved to the database and cache is automatically cleared.

placeholders.about_header_description: We are dedicated to revolutionizing the dealership industry with cutting-edge technology and a passion for excellence.
placeholders.about_mission_description_1: Bilskyen was born from a simple idea: to create a dealership management system that is powerful, intuitive, and affordable. We saw the challenges dealerships faced with outdated, complex software and knew there was a better way.
placeholders.about_mission_description_2: Our mission is to provide a comprehensive, all-in-one platform that streamlines every aspect of dealership operations, from inventory management and sales to accounting and customer relations. We empower owners and staff to work smarter, not harder, freeing them to focus on what truly matters: building relationships and growing their business.
placeholders.about_values_description: The principles that guide every decision we make.
placeholders.about_value_3_description: Our customers are our partners. We succeed when they succeed, and we're dedicated to providing exceptional support and value.
placeholders.about_value_4_description: We operate with the highest ethical standards, building trust through reliability, honesty, and a commitment to excellence.
placeholders.about_team_description: The passionate individuals driving Bilskyen forward.
placeholders.about_team_member_1_description: With a passion for technology and the automotive industry, Muhammed founded Bilskyen to bring modern, efficient solutions to dealerships.
placeholders.about_team_member_2_description: Jane is the architect behind our robust platform, ensuring a seamless and powerful user experience.
placeholders.about_team_member_3_description: John connects with our clients, understanding their needs and helping them leverage Bilskyen for maximum growth.
placeholders.about_cta_description: Ready to see how Bilskyen can transform your dealership? Explore our features or get in touch with our team today.
placeholders.about_value_1_description: We constantly push the boundaries of what's possible, integrating the latest technology to solve real-world dealership challenges.
placeholders.about_value_2_description: We believe in honest, clear communication and pricing. What you see is what you get, from our software to our support.
